title: chronchain
tagline: Chronchain is bringing valuable real life asset in decentralized Finance.
description:
Chronchain is building a Progressive Web App platform for digitization and fractionalization of valuable assets thanks to the Ethereum Blockchain.

Business can tokenize their valuable assets as Non Fungible Token, to enable customers to own, manage, trade and plan the succession of assets they own for a return from Sale or Rent.
how_its_made:
The project is using ERC721 standard to tokenize real life valuable real life assets(rental property, taxis..) as NFTs.

We are also using a relayer and the EIP721 for transactions signature to make costless transactions.

And our customers can collateralise 50% of their NFts value to unlock the credit Delegation functionality.
